title: Timestamp native mailbox route-miss records in UTC and count evictions
outcome: Each retained nativeRouteMisses record has an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, and the existing diagnostics section reports how many older rows have been evicted since process start.
acceptance: The diagnostic records match the UTC timestamp format of the existing home RPC failure history.
The reported evicted count increments when the bounded 64-entry history drops its oldest record and resets with its process-local history.
Deterministic tests cover the reported count and boundary behavior without timing-based assertions.
